messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>, ACME Procurement <procure@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ commit: final stage confirmations + 48h rollup

Team / Acme,

Quick EOQ check-in — we have ~48 hours before the close window and need a tight commit state for ACME-8732. Please do the following by EOD tomorrow so finance can lock the forecast: 

- Sales owners: confirm Stage -> Commit or Pull for all ACME opportunities in your book (use the attached tracker). Mark any conditional commits with the gating requirement (PO received, SOW signed, legal redlines cleared).
- Finance: flag any rev recognition concerns for revised payment schedules.
- Ops/CS: confirm delivery kickoff readiness for first 30 days if we flip to Commit.

Attachments: Acme_Q3_commit_tracker.xlsx (primary), SOW_Acme_Signed.pdf (signed SOW from procurement).

Short asks for each of you:
- Marissa: update expected close date + whether you need a 1-week courtesy credit if PO slips.
- Ben: confirm contract counterparty for billing entity and if we need a separate invoice cadence.
- ACME (Olivia): confirm PO ETA and that SOW page 3 pricing table is final.

I will pull a rollup on Sat morning and send the consolidated commit line into finance. If anything is uncertain, mark as Pull and add a one-line rationale in the tracker.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ commit: final stage confirmations + 48h rollup

Evelyn — I updated the tracker with ACME rows. Summary:
- ACME Analytics (ACME-8732): moving to Commit pending PO; expected PO on Mon 6/28 per Olivia. Marked as Conditional-Commit with "PO ETA Mon 6/28" in the notes column.
- Billing entity: ACME North America (Ben, please confirm the legal name for invoice).
- Revenue timing: Finance note - recognize on delivery start (per SOW), no milestone billing.

Attachments: I attached my annotated tracker view as a second tab.

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- Billing legal name confirmed: "Acme Analytics, Inc." (matches SOW). I'll route invoices to billing@acmeanalytics.com unless procurement requests otherwise.
- SOW pricing table is final — Olivia confirmed to us on the call that the procurement team has signed off.
